title: Choose the visual direction for BrewPoints
subtitle: Web Admin Dashboard, Barista <10s Counter POS, and Mobile Loyalty Wallet

options.label: Kissaten Ticket Book (Kōhī Ken)
options.lineage: Japanese kissaten perforated coffee ticket books, hanko validation stamps, and walnut counter trays
options.thesis: Loyalty points, dynamic QR passes, and counter POS scans crafted like a tactile kissaten coffee ticket ledger.
options.viewport: Deep roast walnut navigation rail framing warm ticket-stock work panes, perforated 10-stub reward progress strips, and tabular monospace spend/point calculators.
options.risk: Perforation and stamp motifs must stay crisp and structural so the screen never feels like stationary clipart.

raised.raise: Every reward, staff account, and ledger row wears a crisp tabular serial code (RWD-01, TX-1042).
Every headline KPI on the Owner Dashboard pairs its primary figure with an immediate breakdown proof beneath.
Mobile Customer Wallet and Staff Scanner anchor primary QR actions in the lower thumb zone for one-handed counter use.
Earned point milestones and confirmed redemptions register as physical punch-holes and hanko marks rather than generic pills.

options.label: Roastery Cupping & Lot Ledger
options.lineage: Specialty coffee roastery green-bean lot cards and SCA cupping protocol sheets
options.thesis: Customer accounts, spend calculations, and rewards organized like an artisanal roastery lot ledger and cupping sheet.
options.viewport: Top roastery header bar over a structured 3-column cupping ledger grid with lot-tagged reward cards and spend calculator.
options.risk: Also the direction most specialty coffee software lands on—high domain fit, lower surprise.

options.label: Split-Flap Concourse Counter
options.lineage: Rush-hour rail concourse split-flap departure boards (signals-instruments-split-flap-concourse)
options.thesis: The coffee bar counter and loyalty ledger as a live departure board built for sub-10-second rush-hour clarity.
options.viewport: Matte-black split-flap header cells for live JWS token countdowns and point totals above a high-contrast tabular transaction concourse.
options.case: Fuses cleanly with the <10s barista counter scan requirement and live token TTLs; loses narrowly to Kissaten on warm coffee-shop intimacy.
options.risk: Can feel overly industrial if the matte black flap cells overpower the warmth of the cafe.

options.label: Goldenrod Pocket Timetable
options.lineage: 1971 pocket airline timetable on a lit goldenrod bed (rw-timetable-slide-rack)
options.thesis: A single-type-size operational rack where rank is carried purely by weight, case, reversal, and crisp rules.
options.viewport: Lateral rack of ivory operational panes over a warm goldenrod bed with one reversed carbon plate highlighting the active counter scan.
options.case: Holds product clarity through strict typographic discipline and single-plate focus; loses on coffee-house audience recognition.
options.risk: Single-size typography requires ruthless discipline to keep hero point balances legible at arm's length.

options.label: Factory Catalog Sleeve
options.lineage: Factory Records FAC catalog numbering and coded hue blocks (brand-identity-canon-saville-catalog-sleeve)
options.thesis: Every reward and transaction indexed by serial catalog code and color-block legend.
options.viewport: Stark black field with pulsar point velocity plot and FAC-numbered reward rows.
options.risk: Coded color strips slow down <10s counter scanning.
options.case: Fuses poorly: baristas and customers cannot decode abstract color strips during a morning espresso rush.
options.kept: Serial catalog numbering (RWD-01, TX-1042) in tabular monospace across every reward and transaction.

options.label: Monochrome Proof Grid
options.thesis: Near-black on near-white neutral scale where every headline figure pairs immediately with its proof.
options.viewport: Two-column neutral grid pairing each KPI claim with its transaction table proof.
options.risk: Reads like generic enterprise SaaS rather than an independent coffee house.
options.case: Fuses poorly: lacks the warmth and tactile character of a specialty coffee loyalty card.
options.kept: Immediate claim-and-proof pairing on every Owner Dashboard KPI card.

options.label: Vertical Snap Feed
options.lineage: Full-bleed vertical media feed with lower-right thumb rail (pop-culture-shelf-vertical-video-feed-surface)
options.thesis: One card owns the entire mobile viewport with thumb-zone action glyphs.
options.viewport: Full-screen QR card with stacked right-rail action triggers.
options.risk: Breaks multi-panel desktop admin and POS workflows.
options.case: Fuses poorly: multi-column POS and Owner Analytics cannot live inside a single-item vertical video feed.
options.kept: Single-thumb lower-zone ergonomics on the Mobile Customer Wallet and Staff Scanner.

options.label: Punched Acetate Manual
options.lineage: Boxed software reference manual with punched acetate leaves (rw-manual-acetate-tab-board)
options.thesis: Stepped fore-edge section tabs and punched-hole selection states over vivid divider boards.
options.viewport: Four-column manual grid with a stepped fore-edge tab rail and punched-hole active states.
options.risk: Boxed software manual metaphor feels disconnected from coffee hospitality.
options.case: Fuses poorly on audience identification for cafe customers, though its tactile state grammar is sharp.
options.kept: Physical punch-hole state marks for earned point milestones and redeemed tickets.

canonCard.label: Modern Cafe POS & Loyalty Standard
canonCard.thesis: Clean warm-neutral SaaS dashboard and mobile wallet executed with high typographic craft.
canonCard.viewport: Standard left sidebar admin shell, two-column POS, and stacked mobile wallet cards.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from standard Square/Toast loyalty templates by design.
